label: A review of chronic enterocolitis of rhesus macaques (
summary: Chronic enterocolitis (CE) is a disease of significant concern in colony-housed rhesus macaques, leading to chronic diarrhea and severe weight loss necessitating euthanasia in up to 25% of adults. Despite over three decades of research into this syndrome, mitigating strategies have been met with variable success and chronic diarrhea remains an ongoing problem in research colonies.
